question: Raut Nacha is a famous folk dance form of _____ state of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __Chhattisgarh.__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Raut Nacha Dance__

 __
 
• Raut Nacha is a dance performed by Yadav/yaduvanshis, a caste that considers them to be descendants of Krishna.
 
• The dance is a close resemblance to Krishna's dance or raas Lela.
 
• The dance form carries with itself a sacred mythological and religious undertone revered from generations.
 
• The dance is very similar to the dance of Lord Krishna with gopis. 
 
• Dancers wear bright and colourful dresses and dance at the beat of music and songs sung by other group members.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chhattisgarh__

 __
 
• Capital- Raipur
 
• State bird- Hill myna
 
• State animal- Wild Buffalo
 
• State tree- Sal
 
• State flower- *Rhynchostylis*__* *__*gigantea*__
 
• State Parks- Guru Ghasidas National Park, Indravati National Park, Kanger Valley National Park
